events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Today marks the 87th birthday of the legendary English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is truly timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', a double LP showcasing a diverse range of styles.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles dropped their iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that still sounds incredible. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, who would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years on, we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury, a voice and showman like no other. He would have been 80 today. His legend truly lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' critically acclaimed album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on this day in 1965, marking a significant artistic progression for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Vibe
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly showed their evolution and set the stage for so much more. Pure genius.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles, who would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: On this day, we pause to remember John Lennon, 46 years since his passing. His music and message of peace, love, and understanding would have seen him turn 86 today.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the visionary English singer, songwriter, and actor David Bowie, a true icon of reinvention and influence.

angles.name: Starman's Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. A true innovator whose artistic legacy continues to inspire. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Today would have been the 92nd birthday of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, whose groundbreaking music and iconic performances changed popular culture forever.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. The King's music still sounds as fresh and exciting as ever.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page, co-founder of Led Zeppelin and one of rock's most influential figures.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin legend's riffs continue to define rock and inspire generations of guitarists.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Today, the distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday, marking decades of hits as a solo artist and with bands like Faces.

angles.name: Maggie May Turns 82
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Rod Stewart! From rock anthems to timeless ballads, his voice is truly one-of-a-kind.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the iconic frontman of the British ska band Madness.

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the brilliant Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing us hits and good times for decades. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Today, the soulful British singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday, known for his smooth vocals and 80s chart-toppers.

angles.name: Wherever I Lay My Hat
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! That distinctive voice gave us some of the biggest and best tracks of the 80s.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Today would have been the 81st birthday of the beloved American singer, songwriter, and cultural icon Dolly Parton, whose influence on music and beyond is immeasurable.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 today. A true legend whose songs and spirit continue to brighten the world.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Happy 56th birthday to English singer, songwriter, and Take That frontman Gary Barlow, one of the UK's most successful musical talents.

angles.name: Take That Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! A fantastic songwriter and the heart of Take That. What's your favourite Gary-penned hit?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Today, the Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday, known for his string of international R&B and pop hits in the 70s and 80s.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth-voiced Billy Ocean! Get ready to dance to some timeless hits today.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held first induction 41 years ago
events.blurb: On this day in 1986, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony in New York City, honouring rock's pioneering legends.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: 41 years ago, rock history was made! The very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place, celebrating the legends who shaped the sound of generations.

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Happy 55th birthday to English singer and songwriter Mark Owen, best known as a member of the iconic pop group Take That.

angles.name: Take That's Mark
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From Take That's early days to his solo career, he's given us so many great pop moments.
